summary: Globus Maritime Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing delivery of the M/V Glbs Olympia, a 2026-built Ultramax dry bulk carrier of approximately 64,000 DWT constructed at Nihon Shipyard Co. in Japan, previously announced on August 23, 2023. The delivery, dated September 14, 2026, expands Globus's fleet to ten dry bulk carriers totaling roughly 744,622 DWT with a weighted average age of about eight years. CEO Athanasios Feidakis framed the addition as fleet-renewal progress. No price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms were stated; this is a routine operational fleet update, not a special situation.
